```{r}
library(geodata)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(terra)

# 1. Descargar límites de Perú a nivel departamental
peru_raw <- geodata::gadm(country = "PER", level = 1, path = tempdir())
peru <- st_as_sf(peru_raw)

# 2. Datos de vacunación por departamento
vac_data <- data.frame(
  NAME_1 = c("Tumbes", "Piura", "Lambayeque", "La Libertad", "Cajamarca",
             "Amazonas", "San Martín", "Loreto", "Ancash", "Huánuco",
             "Pasco", "Ucayali", "Junín", "Lima", "Callao", "Huancavelica",
             "Ayacucho", "Cusco", "Apurímac", "Madre de Dios", "Puno",
             "Arequipa", "Moquegua", "Tacna", "Ica"),
  porcentaje = c(82.6, 83.0, 85.1, 85.9, 83.4, 83.2, 74.1, 74.1, 82.0, 82.0,
                 89.2, 74.3, 86.7, 86.0, 86.0, 78.7, 86.0, 79.5, 74.5, 72.0,
                 87.0, 82.9, 82.0, 82.1, 83.6)
)

# 3. Unir datos espaciales con datos de vacunación
peru_mapa <- left_join(peru, vac_data, by = "NAME_1")

# 4. Crear categorías discretas y eliminar filas sin categoría
peru_mapa <- peru_mapa %>%
  mutate(categoria = cut(porcentaje,
                         breaks = c(70, 75, 80, 85, 90, 100),
                         labels = c("70-75%", "75-80%", "80-85%", "85-90%", "90-100%"),
                         include.lowest = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(categoria))

# 5. Calcular centroides para las etiquetas
centroids <- st_centroid(peru_mapa)

# Función auxiliar para crear sombras gruesas (desplazamientos)
shadow_offsets <- expand.grid(
  x = c(-0.06, 0, 0.06),
  y = c(-0.06, 0, 0.06)
) %>% filter(!(x == 0 & y == 0))

# 6. Crear el mapa
p <- ggplot(peru_mapa) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = categoria), color = "gray30")

# Añadir sombras: varias capas desplazadas en blanco
for(i in seq_len(nrow(shadow_offsets))) {
  p <- p + geom_text(
    data = centroids,
    aes(label = NAME_1, geometry = geometry),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = 2.2,
    family = "Impact",
    color = "white",
    nudge_x = shadow_offsets$x[i],
    nudge_y = shadow_offsets$y[i]
  )
}

# Añadir texto negro centrado
p <- p + geom_text(
  data = centroids,
  aes(label = NAME_1, geometry = geometry),
  stat = "sf_coordinates",
  size = 2.2,
  family = "Impact",
  color = "black"
) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Cobertura (%)",
    values = c("70-75%" = "#ffffff", 
               "75-80%" = "#bfbfbf", 
               "80-85%" = "#7f7f7f", 
               "85-90%" = "#404040", 
               "90-100%" = "#000000"),
    drop = TRUE
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )

print(p)

```
